messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic number field construction optimizing 3x3 determinant spectra

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Optimal 13-point minimum-area configurations arise from projecting the 13 shortest vectors of the hexagonal lattice \(\\mathbb{Z}[\\omega]\\) (where \(\\omega = e^{2\\pi i/3}\\)) into the unit square via a linear map whose scaling factors are units in \(\\mathbb{Q}(\\sqrt{13})\\), yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly \(\\frac{1}{312}=\\frac{1}{24\\cdot 13}\\). The algebraic structure forces every 3x3 determinant in the resulting coordinate matrix to be an integer multiple of this fundamental area, and the quadratic field choice minimizes the spectral ratio between the smallest and second-smallest determinant values, preventing any local perturbation from collapsing the minimum."}
